items.markdown:
Mango sticky rice (*khao niao mamuang* ) is `a classic, beloved traditional Thai dessert` . It features steamed, sweet glutinous (sticky) rice infused with a rich, sweetened coconut milk syrup. This is served alongside slices of perfectly ripe, fragrant yellow mango and often drizzled with a salty-sweet coconut sauce.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/)[[2]](https://www.seriouseats.com/thai-coconut-sticky-rice-mango-recipe)

The Core Elements

A traditional serving of mango sticky rice balances four distinct elements, which together create its famous sweet-and-salty profile:[[1]](https://www.joyousapron.com/thai-mango-sweet-sticky-rice/)

- **The Rice:** Glutinous "sweet" rice—steamed rather than boiled—is macerated in a sweet coconut mixture. It develops a dense, chewy, and glossy texture similar to mochi.
- **The Mango:** Only the sweetest, ripest, non-fibrous varieties (such as the Ataulfo, Nam Dok Mai, or Champagne mango) are used.
- **The Sauce:** A thick, slightly salted coconut cream is generously poured over the warm rice to balance out its sweetness.
- **The Topping:** Crispy fried mung beans or toasted sesame seeds are traditionally sprinkled on top for an added crunch.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/) [[1]](https://www.joyousapron.com/thai-mango-sweet-sticky-rice/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYKybQ_RTyZ/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/sticky-rice-mango)

Where to Find It While you can make it easily at home using a [Hot Thai Kitchen Mango Sticky Rice Recipe](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/) , it is a staple dessert in Thai restaurants and Southeast Asian markets across the globe.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/mango-sticky-rice/)
